adaptations: Renamed the module to is-qualitative-analysis and declared bundled OpenAI4S origin with no network capability.
Removed Claude-only tool permissions, external suite routing and optional package requirements; resources are self-contained and read with host.skills.read.
Added IS interviews/cases, immutable source Artifact versions, excerpt locators, negative cases, interpretation limits and human review disclosure.
Conditioned codebooks on the selected method and clarified that consensus and reliability coefficients are not required targets of reflexive thematic analysis.
Adapted nominal coincidence alpha and pairwise agreement into kernel.py; validated rows and coder names, preserved missingness audit, and corrected undefined constant-category Cohen kappa.
Omitted the CLI runner, automatic unit bootstrap and generic reliability thresholds; uncertainty is explicitly not estimated and needs a design-specific sampling unit.
Removed the invalid interpretation of overlapping agreement CIs as human/model equivalence and distinguished model assistance from independent human coding.
Preserved exact AlterLab MIT LICENSE and the inherited K-Dense MIT notice from upstream THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; no noncommercial pipeline content was imported.
Added bilingual directory documentation and independently derived offline numeric regression tests.
